cmd: MODEL_CONFIG=$(find /models/qwen3-8b -type f -name config.json -print -quit); test -n "$MODEL_CONFIG" || { echo 'Qwen config.json not found under /models/qwen3-8b' >&2; find /models/qwen3-8b -maxdepth 4 -type f | head -100 >&2; exit 1; }; MODEL_DIR=$(dirname "$MODEL_CONFIG"); echo "Starting Qwen from $MODEL_DIR"; exec python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --model "$MODEL_DIR" --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen3-8B --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --dtype auto --max-model-len 4096 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --reasoning-parser qwen3
